name: tinker-large-file
description: Large File Cleaner Plugin for TINKER

tinker.name: Large File Cleaner
tinker.description: Scan and clean large files to free disk space

zh-CN.name: 大文件清理
zh-CN.description: 扫描和清理大文件，释放磁盘空间

scan.description: Scan a directory for large files (≥ 10MB). Updates the plugin UI and returns files sorted by size.

path.description: Absolute path to the directory to scan

get.description: Get the current large-file list. Call scan first.

filter.description: Optional file-type filter. Defaults to the current UI filter.

clean.description: Delete selected large files by path. Call scan first, inspect with get, then pass paths to remove. Skips the UI confirm dialog.

paths.description: Absolute file paths to delete from the current scan results

moveToTrash.description: Move files to trash instead of permanent delete. Defaults to the current UI setting.
